The Lower Saxony Science Minister visits GEO600 in 2019

On 22 January 2019, the Lower Saxony Science Minister Björn Thümler visited the GEO600 site.

He was taken on a tour of the detector and its laboratories by Karsten Danzmann, then director (now director emeritus) at the @mpi_grav in Hannover and then director of the Institute for Gravitational Physics at @unihannover@wisskomm.social.
